name: ArtiSys SEO
boundary: Portable SEO configuration, technical artifact generation, deterministic auditing, dashboard view-models and an optional Search Console read-only adapter. Product hosting and content stay in the consumer. Google OAuth credentials are injected or reused from local environment/rclone and are never hardcoded in the module.
limitations: Search Console network requests only occur when its explicit adapter, report/check command or OAuth bootstrap is used.
The OAuth bootstrap saves a Search Console token separately from the rclone Drive token.
A deployed consumer must receive Client ID, Client Secret and refresh token through its own secret store; secrets are never committed by this module.
First-party analytics, conversion tracking and D1 persistence remain separate future capabilities.
